source.title: Fix: Properly update private attrs with model_copy, update= and extra=allow

input.diff_text:
diff --git a/pydantic/main.py b/pydantic/main.py
--- a/pydantic/main.py
+++ b/pydantic/main.py
@@ -405,16 +405,18 @@ def model_copy(self, *, update: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, deep: bool = Fa
         """
         copied = self.__deepcopy__() if deep else self.__copy__()
         if update:
-            if self.model_config.get('extra') == 'allow':
-                for k, v in update.items():
-                    if k in self.__pydantic_fields__:
-                        copied.__dict__[k] = v
-                    else:
+            for k, v in update.items():
+                if k in self.__pydantic_fields__:
+                    copied.__dict__[k] = v
+                elif k in self.__private_attributes__:
+                    if copied.__pydantic_private__ is None:
+                        copied.__pydantic_private__ = {}
+                    copied.__pydantic_private__[k] = v
+                else:
+                    if self.model_config.get('extra') == 'allow':
                         if copied.__pydantic_extra__ is None:
                             copied.__pydantic_extra__ = {}
                         copied.__pydantic_extra__[k] = v
-            else:
-                copied.__dict__.update(update)
             copied.__pydantic_fields_set__.update(update.keys())
         return copied

issues.description: Private-attribute keys are now intercepted for every extra mode instead of only preserving the existing extra handling. That changes model_copy(update=...) semantics for users who relied on private-looking names being carried as extra data, which maintainers called out as a compatibility concern.
issues.repair_unit: preserve model_copy(update=...) compatibility while routing private-attribute keys
issues.mechanism_pattern: model_copy intercepts private-attribute keys before preserving the prior extra-mode update behavior
issues.invariant_pattern: model_copy(update=...) must not reclassify update keys in a way that changes existing compatibility semantics
